WITH po AS (SELECT id FROM purchase_orders WHERE submitted_at >= '2026-09-01' AND submitted_at < '2026-10-01') SELECT p.category, SUM(i.line_total) AS amount, SUM(i.quantity) AS cases, SUM(i.line_total) * 100.0 / SUM(SUM(i.line_total)) OVER () AS amount_share_pct, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM purchase_order_items AS i JOIN po ON po.id = i.po_id LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.id = i.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 100

WITH confirmed_reports AS (SELECT id, reporting_period FROM sales_reports WHERE status = 'confirmed'), periods AS (SELECT DISTINCT reporting_period FROM confirmed_reports ORDER BY reporting_period DESC LIMIT 6) SELECT cr.reporting_period, SUM(rf.numeric_value) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS fact_count FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN confirmed_reports AS cr ON rf.report_id = cr.id JOIN periods AS p ON cr.reporting_period = p.reporting_period WHERE rf.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.metric_key = 'revenue' GROUP BY cr.reporting_period ORDER BY cr.reporting_period

WITH latest AS (SELECT id, reporting_period, period_start, period_end FROM sales_reports WHERE status = 'confirmed' ORDER BY period_end DESC NULLS LAST, reporting_period DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT p.sku, p.product_name_en, p.product_name_native, rf.numeric_value AS stock_on_hand, rf.unit, l.reporting_period, l.period_start, l.period_end FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN latest AS l ON rf.report_id = l.id LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.id = rf.product_id WHERE rf.metric_key = 'stock_on_hand' AND rf.status = 'confirmed' ORDER BY p.sku
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM contracts GROUP BY status LIMIT 100

SELECT DISTINCT metric_key, fact_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM report_facts WHERE status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY metric_key, fact_type ORDER BY metric_key LIMIT 100

WITH rev AS (SELECT SUM(rf.numeric_value) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS fact_count FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN sales_reports AS sr ON sr.id = rf.report_id WHERE sr.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.metric_key = 'revenue' AND rf.period_start >= '2026-10-01' AND rf.period_end <= '2026-10-31'), tgt AS (SELECT c.annual_sales_target, c.annual_sales_target_currency FROM contracts AS c WHERE c.status = 'active' ORDER BY c.effective_from DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) SELECT rev.revenue, rev.fact_count, tgt.annual_sales_target, tgt.annual_sales_target_currency, CASE WHEN NOT tgt.annual_sales_target IS NULL AND CAST((tgt.annual_sales_target ->> 'amount') AS DECIMAL) > 0 THEN rev.revenue / CAST((tgt.annual_sales_target ->> 'amount') AS DECIMAL) * 100 END AS completion_percent FROM rev CROSS JOIN tgt

answer:
2026年9月采购月报已生成，请在右侧对应标签里查看。

**主要情况：**
*   **销售额**：9月已确认销售额为 2,231.20，较8月的 2,251.46 减少 20.26，约 -0.9%。因系统未返回生效合同记录，缺少销售目标数据，无法计算完成度（不能视为0）。
*   **采购量**：9月提交采购单共6个产品行，合计 484 箱，金额合计 11,990.17。采购最多的是 Bouteille d'eau evian 6L（132箱），其次是 Evian+ Himbeere & Gingseng 33cl ALU（102箱）和 bouteille d'eau（111箱）。
*   **库存风险**：三款在售产品期末库存合计 310 件，预计剩余天数均不足9天（约 8.3–8.5 天），存在断档风险。
*   **待处理事项**：有 11 张未完成采购单，其中 8 张被标记逾期（7张待付款、1张已提交），建议优先跟进付款状态。
